methodological_note: Primary decision strictly follows Berger Intersection-Union Test (IUT) on paired parametric t-tests at one-sided alpha=0.025 (two-sided 95% CI upper bound < 0 for H1a and < +0.00010 for H1b). Sign and Wilcoxon tests assess different nulls (median=bound and symmetry around bound) and are reported strictly as robustness diagnostics.
